### Summary
Support ticket reduction analysis covering AI bot language bugs and escalation failures.
AI bot language bugs: Prompt structure issues caused bot Livia to switch languages unexpectedly.
Contact correlation trip errors: System issues occurred when Livia failed to find contacts inside Salesforce.
Area manager escalation failures: Escalation notifications failed to tag appropriate managers due to empty N3 fields.

### Decisions
Aligned
  - Scheduling follow-up status update meeting: The participants agreed to hold a follow-up meeting next Wednesday at the same time to review the AI fix ETAs and investigate further.

### Details
  - Meeting Purpose and Ticket Reduction Analysis: Julia Diaz and Paola Marin convened the meeting to address a noticeable reduction in support tickets received by Paola Marin's team, first identified in HubSpot by Camila Flores. Julia noted drivers are texting area managers' personal cell phones because support isn't resolving their issues.
  - AI Bot Language and Prompt Bugs: Camila presented cases of Livia switching between Spanish and English, stating "I'm not able to help," failing to open tickets, or closing them prematurely. Felipe explained Livia's prompts are entirely in English without localization context; known bug mapped by the AI team, fix in progress.
  - Contact Correlation and Trip Status Errors: Livia tells drivers "you are not on a trip" when it cannot correlate the HubSpot semi-contact with Salesforce; redirects them to the app. Felipe to confirm with AI team whether intended or a bug.
  - Area Manager Escalation Failures: Julia raised cases where Livia promises AM escalation but nothing happens. Escalations post to the channel but sometimes fail to tag AMs, or the N3 field stays empty. Felipe will investigate / report to Thiago; asked Camila for case links.
  - Follow-Up Schedule: Camila shared the document with HubSpot conversation links. Follow-up next Wednesday same time; Felipe expects ETA for AI fixes and a structured log by then.
  - Trip Status Marking Discrepancies: Camila reported trips marked complete by support without notice. Paola said agents must not manipulate trip statuses and will review the ticket.
